newsitem.title: USA: Apollo/Koll holds 7 pct Santa Anita stake.
newsitem.headline: Apollo/Koll holds 7 pct Santa Anita stake.

text.p: Apollo Real Estate Advisors and The Koll Co said they hold a stake of about 7 percent in Santa Anita Realty Enterprises Inc and Santa Anita Operating Co, which are traded as paired shares.
According to a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Apollo and Koll hold 808,000 paired shares of the Santa Anita companies, purchased for $15.6 million.

The shares represent a stake of 7.10 percent in Santa Anita Realty and 7.17 percent in Santa Anita Operating, the filing showed. On October 9, Apollo and Koll made an unsolicited offer involving a recapitalization of the Santa Anita companies.

In the proposed recapitalization, each Santa Anita shareholder would receive at least $17 for each paired share held, constituting $14 in cash to be paid as a special dividend and at least $3 in paired shares which would continue to be held by the shareholder after the recapitalization, according to the filing.

Koll would make an initial cash investment of at least $50 million, which will be used along with "an anticipated financing" to pay the dividend. The dividend will be paid to all stockholders other than Koll Arcadia Investors LLC, the filing said.

In exchange, Koll Arcadia will receive newly issued paired shares represeneting a 9.8 percent stake in the Santa Anita companies and interests in two newly formed limited liability entities equal in value to the balance of Koll Arcadia's investment.

Koll Arcadia then proposes a rights offering in which shareholders may buy up to $50 million of equity in the Santa Anita companies at $2 for each new paired share. Koll Arcadia would be prepared to serve as a stanby purchaser in the rights offering.
Following completion of the rights offering, Koll Arcadia will invest up to an additional $100 million in the Santa Anita companies, according to the filing.
